report.tagline: ixigo is a travel app for everyday Indians, built around train tickets, buses and budget flights.
report.simpleSummary: ixigo helps you book train, bus and flight tickets and hotels from one app. Its big strength is trains: it tells you if your waitlisted ticket will confirm, where your train is right now, and which platform it will come on. It also owns ConfirmTkt for trains and AbhiBus for buses. It is listed on the stock market and makes a profit.

overview.whatItDoes: ixigo is an online travel agent (OTA) focused on budget travellers in smaller cities. It sells train tickets as an authorised IRCTC partner, bus tickets through AbhiBus, flight tickets, and hotels. It earns a small fee or commission on each booking and on add-ons like free cancellation.
howItWorks: You search a route and see trains, buses and flights together with prices and times.
For trains, the app shows confirmation chance for waitlisted tickets and suggests alternatives.
You log in with your IRCTC ID and book; ixigo charges a small convenience fee.
Add-ons like ixigo Assured (free cancellation) cost a small extra amount.
During the trip, live train status, PNR status and platform info keep you coming back.
An AI trip planner helps plan itineraries and answer questions.
overview.valueProposition: The easiest way for regular Indians to plan and book trains, buses and cheap flights, with tools that reduce the worry of waitlists and delays.

businessModel.summary: ixigo makes money from small fees on train tickets, commissions on bus and flight tickets and hotels, add-ons like free cancellation, and some ads.

revenueStreams.detail: A small fee on each IRCTC ticket booked.
A cut from bus operators through AbhiBus.
Commission from airlines, hotels and partners.
ixigo Assured, travel insurance and others.
Ads to the large base of users checking train status.

businessModel.pricing: Fare plus convenience fee shown at checkout. Free cancellation add-ons cost extra and vary by ticket.
businessModel.unitEconomics: On a ₹1,000 train ticket, ixigo may earn about ₹30 to ₹60 from the convenience fee and add-ons. That is small, but it costs almost nothing to get the user, because they already use ixigo for free train status. A bus ticket earns more, often 8% to 12% commission. Low marketing cost per booking is why ixigo makes a profit while many travel apps do not.

howTheyGetUsers: Free train status and PNR search that rank high on Google
Buying ConfirmTkt and AbhiBus to add users
Word of mouth in small towns
Cross-selling buses and flights to train users
whatBringsUsersBack: Checking train status on every trip
Festival and holiday travel every year
growth.moat: ixigo has years of data on train waitlists, delays and routes, and a huge base of users who open the app for free utilities. Big players like MakeMyTrip focus on richer flyers, so the budget train-first user is ixigo's home ground.

pmLessons: A free, useful tool (train status) can be the cheapest way to get users.
Serving a less glamorous segment can be a profitable niche.
Small fees add up when you have very low costs to get each user.
Buying apps in nearby categories can speed up growth.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you increase ixigo's flight bookings among train users?
interviewQuestions.hint: Find users on long routes, show the price gap, offer first-flight help.

interviewQuestions.question: What should ixigo build with AI?
interviewQuestions.hint: Pick a real pain like waitlists or delays. Describe the flow and a metric.

interviewQuestions.question: Design ixigo for a first-time smartphone user in a village.
interviewQuestions.hint: Voice, local language, simple flow, trust signals.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you measure success of ixigo Assured?
interviewQuestions.hint: Attach rate, claims, repeat bookings, profit per add-on.

interviewQuestions.question: IRCTC raises the partner fee. What do you do?
interviewQuestions.hint: Model impact, pass on part, push add-ons, grow bus.
